population_note: The census counts of its islands added up: Banaba, Butaritari, Marakei, Abaiang, Tarawa Ieta, Tarawa Teinainano, Betio, Maiana, Abemama, Kuria, Aranuka, Nonouti, Tabiteuea North, Tabiteuea South, Beru, Nikunau, Onotoa, Tamana, Arorae, Makin.
median_age_note: Median age interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the Pacific Community's tabulation of the 2020 census by island, five-year age group and sex (UNFPA and OCHA's COD-PS for Kiribati, "Baseline used: Kiribati NSO"), which counts 108,661 people here against the census's final 108,145. The same tabulation gives the country a median of 22.9, and the Statistics Office's own Census Atlas prints 22.9. The General Report prints medians by island and division, not by island group, and its island figures (Table A-10a) are not used, for the reason each island's record gives.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females, 2020 census (General Report, Table G-2: 52,993 males, 55,152 females). The islands added up: Banaba, Butaritari, Marakei, Abaiang, North Tarawa, South Tarawa, Betio, Maiana, Abemama, Kuria, Aranuka, Nonouti, North Tabiteuea, South Tabiteuea, Beru, Nikunau, Onotoa, Tamana, Arorae, Makin.
ethnicity_note: Ethnicity, 2020 census (General Report, Table A-3b, which the report prints as a picture of the table; transcribed). 'I-Kiribati/mixed' is the table's 'Kiribati/Mix' and 'American' its 'USA'. The islands added up: Banaba, Butaritari, Marakei, Abaiang, North Tarawa, South Tarawa, Betio, Maiana, Abemama, Kuria, Aranuka, Nonouti, North Tabiteuea, South Tabiteuea, Beru, Nikunau, Onotoa, Tamana, Arorae, Makin.
religion_note: Religion of the 99,633 people of Gilbert Islands at the 2015 census (Volume 1, Table 6, by island), the latest count of it below the country: the 2020 census publishes religion for the country (General Report, Table G-3) and maps it by island without figures (Census Atlas, Map 18). The islands added up: Banaba, Butaritari, Marakei, Abaiang, NTarawa, STarawa, Betio, Maiana, Abemama, Kuria, Aranuka, Nonouti, NTabiteuea, STabiteuea, Beru, Nikunau, Onotoa, Tamana, Arorae, Makin. Counted with the table's 'Other': 84 answering 'Te Ran' and 141 answering 'All Nation', bodies whose tradition the volume does not state. The table has one column for the Kiribati Protestant Church ('KPC'); the 2020 census lists the Kiribati Uniting Church and the KPC apart (21.2% and 8.4% of the country), so the 2015 'KPC' share is to be read against their sum.

median_age.note: Kanton's 41 people are not in the Pacific Community's tabulation of the 2020 census by age, the source of every other island's median here. The General Report prints 17.9 for Kanton (Table A-10a), a column not used for any island: it puts the country at 20.4 against the 22.9 of the Office's own Census Atlas, and 21 of its 23 islands more than a year from what the census's own five-year groups give, by up to 7.4 years.
